name: Bidzina Ivanishvili
role: Honorary Chairman of Georgian Dream; billionaire founder widely described by the US State Department and opposition as the party's de facto leader; sanctioned by the US in Dec 2024
quote: The 'global party of war' is trying to control our country through NGOs — this force bears responsibility for the 2008 war and for pushing Georgia toward confrontation.

name: Irakli Kobakhidze
role: Prime Minister of Georgia; announced the Nov 28, 2024 suspension of EU accession talks and has led the legislative crackdown on civil society and media
quote: We will not initiate accession negotiations with the European Union until 2028, and we will refuse budgetary support from the EU during this period.

name: Mikheil Kavelashvili
role: President of Georgia since Dec 29, 2024; former footballer and Georgian Dream MP elected by a party-controlled electoral college; legitimacy disputed by the opposition and EU Parliament
quote: I was elected in accordance with the constitution of Georgia, and I will serve all citizens of this country as head of state.

name: Shalva Papuashvili
role: Speaker of the Parliament of Georgia; oversaw passage of the Foreign Agents Registration Act, Broadcasting Law and opposition party-ban legislation; announced the Constitutional Court lawsuit against UNM, Ahali and Lelo
quote: These parties have engaged in activities aimed at the violent overthrow of the constitutional order, and the Constitutional Court must rule on their status.

name: Salome Zourabichvili
role: President of Georgia 2018–2024; refused to recognize Kavelashvili's election and continues to describe herself as the country's legitimate head of state; leading international advocate for the opposition
quote: This is a mockery of democracy. I remain the legitimate president of Georgia, and this crisis is bringing the state practically to the verge of collapse.

name: Mikheil Saakashvili
role: President of Georgia 2004–2013; founder of the United National Movement; imprisoned since 2021 with a cumulative sentence of roughly 12.5 years across multiple convictions he and supporters call politically motivated
quote: They can extend my sentence as many times as they like — they will not extend the life of this regime.

name: Nika Gvaramia
role: Leader of the Coalition for Change opposition bloc; former justice and defense minister; jailed July 2025 for refusing to appear before a Georgian Dream parliamentary commission and barred from office for two years
quote: I will not legitimize a commission created to criminalize the entire pro-Western opposition. Prison will not change that.

name: Nika Melia
role: Chair of the United National Movement; detained for refusing to appear before the parliamentary inquiry into the pre-2012 Saakashvili era; one of the party leaders targeted by Georgian Dream's Constitutional Court ban lawsuit
quote: This commission exists for one purpose: to jail as many opposition leaders as possible before the next election.

name: Mamuka Khazaradze
role: Founder of the Lelo for Georgia party and former banker; sentenced to eight months in prison in June 2025 for boycotting the parliamentary commission and barred from public office for two years
quote: We built Lelo to offer Georgians a pragmatic, pro-European alternative — that is precisely why they want us gone.

name: Mzia Amaglobeli
role: Founder of independent outlets Netgazeti and Batumelebi; arrested Jan 2025, sentenced to two years in prison in Aug 2025; awarded the European Parliament's 2025 Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought
quote: This regime destroys free journalism, abolishes opposition political parties and imprisons their leaders... yet it has failed to silence the protests. Fight with us and for us.

name: Sandro Baramidze
role: Head of the Human Rights and Justice Program at Transparency International Georgia; leads the organization's political-prisoner tracking under PACE criteria (91 listed as of July 2026)
quote: There had been more people on this list — some entered plea agreements with the prosecutor's office rather than face trial under these laws.

name: Paata Burchuladze
role: Opera singer and civic activist; called for a 'peaceful revolution' and transfer of power from Ivanishvili at the Oct 4, 2025 rally; arrested afterward and charged with attempting to overthrow the government, facing up to nine years
quote: We are asking for one thing: a peaceful transfer of power away from one man who has held this country hostage for over a decade.

name: Kaja Kallas
role: EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy; repeatedly pressed Georgia to reverse its democratic backsliding at EU foreign ministers' meetings and the OSCE
quote: Georgia shows no signs of reversing its democratic backsliding. Georgia needs to change course, and a sincere engagement in the human rights dialogue would be a sign that they want to change course.

name: European Commission
role: EU executive body; published the 8th visa-suspension mechanism report (Dec 2025), formally suspended visa-free travel for Georgian officials (Mar 2026), and repeatedly called Georgia 'a candidate country in name only'
quote: Georgia remains a candidate country in name only. We call on the Georgian authorities to urgently reverse their democratic backsliding.

name: Vladimir Putin
role: President of Russia; signed May 2025 decrees lifting visa requirements for Georgian citizens and restoring direct Moscow–Tbilisi flights, deepening informal normalization with Georgian Dream even as EU/NATO ties with Tbilisi froze
quote: Restoring direct flights and visa-free travel with Georgia serves the interests of both our peoples.

name: Irakli Garibashvili
role: Prime Minister of Georgia 2013-2015 and 2021-2024; longtime Ivanishvili aide who quit politics in Apr 2025; imprisoned on a five-year money-laundering sentence; publicly broke with Ivanishvili in Aug 2026 alleging pressure into a false confession, and on Aug 24, 2026 was charged with a further bribery count carrying 11-15 years over an inflated Defense Ministry procurement scheme
quote: You set me up with a dirty provocation, laid an unmanly trap for me... but you deceived me and then screwed me over.
